Engineered PostgreSQL full-text search with trigram indexing delivering sub-30ms multi-variant catalog queries.
Integrated dual-layer Meta Conversions API (CAPI) server-to-server event pipeline alongside client browser triggers.
Implemented resilient Razorpay payment webhook processing with exponential backoff retries.
impact: Reduced Core Web Vitals LCP by 68% and brought mobile Time-to-Interactive under 800ms.
Boosted mobile checkout conversion rate by 24% and eliminated payment drop-offs during flash campaigns.
Successfully recovered 35%+ lost ad attribution across paid acquisition channels.

full-stack.project_description: Enterprise-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) conversational agent providing grounded answers from product documentation.
challenge: Preventing LLM hallucinations and ensuring responses strictly reference verified knowledge docs.
Minimizing token costs from sending oversized documentation contexts in prompts.
Eliminating user perceived latency while waiting for multi-sentence LLM completions.
solution: Engineered hybrid markdown chunking pipeline with metadata preservation and cosine similarity retrieval in vector DB.
Enforced strict negative constraints in system prompt directives prohibiting speculative answers.
Implemented Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming pipeline via Next.js Server Actions for real-time token delivery.
impact: Achieved sub-400ms time-to-first-token (TTFT) for seamless conversational perception.
Eliminated over 95% of factual inaccuracies through strict grounding guardrails.
Decreased average user support resolution time from hours to instant conversational answers.
project_highlights: Semantic chunking pipeline with metadata preservation
Low-latency streaming response buffer with Markdown rendering
Negative constraint guardrails preventing out-of-context answers
full-stack.extra_notes: Implemented telemetry logging for query latency and token cost analysis.
